pie: kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. kʷíd tód? tód wékʷos ne wóydh₂e. dʰugh₂trṓm toy moy suHnéwes ph₂téres. nu moy túH ǵénh₁os. gʷṓs wos dinóy h₂éǵete? h₁íns h₂éǵonti h₁eǵóh₂ h₁íns ne h₂éǵoh₂. nu toy kʷís h₂mélǵos dédeh₃ti? wékʷesh₂ toy moy néweh₂.
english: Be well! I come from the future, from the year 2026. What is that? I do not know that word. The sons of your daughters are my fathers. Then you are of my race! Do you drive cattle in your day? They drive them; I do not drive them. Then who gives you milk? I buy it at the supermarket. Your words are new to me!

pie: kʷíd tód? méh₂tēr moy dweh₂róy tḱéyti ḱlush₁yéti-kʷe me. h₁ésyeh₂ey HréwdHsi? ne HréwdHmi. dʰéh₁s h₁ésmi h₁én h₁ésti? dʰéh₁s h₁ésmi h₁én ne h₁ésti. swesréy moy h₂éǵroybʰos HréwdHmi ḱlush₁yéti-kʷe me.
english: I talk to my mother on my phone. What is that? My mother lives far away, and she hears me. Do you cry out to her? I do not cry out. The phone carries my voice through the air. Is a god in it? There is no god in it. I cry out to my sister in the field, and she hears me.

pie: túH wĺ̥kʷos. dh₂pnóm gʷr̥h₃és. túH h₂ówis ne kʷid h₁ḗds trémsi-kʷe. h₁ddʰí wĺ̥kʷos-wē te gʷr̥h₃ḗti. wĺ̥kʷoybʰos ne dedwóyh₂e. nu sddʰí péh₃tlōd-kʷe moy ph₃dʰí.
english: You are a wolf! You devoured the feast. And you are a sheep: you ate nothing, and you tremble! Eat, or the wolf will devour you! I am not afraid of wolves! Then sit down and drink from my cup.

pie: póh₂imen kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. kʷéyes toy deywṓs? ph₂tḗr dyḗws upér stestóh₂e méh₂tēr-kʷe dʰéǵʰōm Hn̥dʰér ḱéyor. h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr Héh₂mr̥ bʰéreti. kʷím gʷr̥néHsi? deywóns ne gʷr̥néHmi. nu toy mē gʰrémoyh₁ent.
english: Be well, shepherd! Who are your gods? Father Sky stands above, and Mother Earth lies below. Dawn, the daughter of Sky, brings the day. And whom do you praise? I do not praise the gods. Then may they not be angry with you!

pie: pótey kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. kʷíd h₂n̥réy h₁wésu? polh₁éwes márkōs suHnéwes ḱléwos-kʷe. h₁suḱléwēs wiHrós gʰostíbʰos dédeh₃ti dʰéh₁sn̥s-kʷe gʷr̥néHti. h₁yód méreti h₁ésyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom. kʷíd toy h₁wésu? priHṓs moy kéh₂nmn̥h₂-kʷe. nu moy h₁íh₂ kh₂né.
english: Be well, master! What is good for a man? Many horses, sons, and fame. A man of good fame gives to guests and praises the gods. When he dies, his fame is imperishable. And what is good for you? My friends and my songs. Then sing them to me!

pie: nu h₁éymi kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. dyḗws te ph₂syéh₁t. h₂ew gʷémtu kéh₂nmn̥h₂-kʷe toy bʰére. h₂ew gʷm̥yṓh₂ túH moy ḱéywos. nu gʷh₂dʰí memónh₂e te.
english: Now I am going; be well! May Sky protect you! Come back, and bring your songs! I will come back; you are dear to me. Go now; I keep you in mind.

pie: h₂nér h₁wésus h₁syéh₁s. kúdʰe tḱéysi? ḱóymoy wédni h₁épi tḱéymi. h₂énHos moy h₁idʰé h₁ésti spéleh₂-kʷe nékʷti mléwHti. kúdʰe toy h₂éwh₂os h₁ésti? péruti mért nu dʰǵʰémi Hn̥dʰér ḱéyor. h₂énHos toy gʷíh₃weti? gʷíh₃weti h₁íh₂-kʷe moy ḱéyweh₂ h₁ésti.
english: May you be fortunate, man! Where do you live? I live in a village near the water. My grandmother is here, and she tells stories at night. And where is your grandfather? He died last year; now he lies under the earth. Is your grandmother alive? She is alive, and she is dear to me.

pie: gʷr̥Hḗi h₂ówis, kʷésyo wlh₂néH ne (h₁é) est, h₁éḱwons spéḱet, h₁oinom gʰe gʷr̥Húm wóǵʰom wéǵʰontm̥ h₁oinom-kʷe méǵHm bʰórom, h₁oinom-kʷe ǵʰménm̥ Hṓḱu bʰérontm̥.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: kéh₂re. túH súpniyom? súpniyom h₂mélǵos ne píph₃eti spéḱye píph₃oh₂. nu kúdʰe h₁ésmi? ḱóymoy moy h₁ési. h₁eǵóh₂ toy súpniyom? ne wóydh₂e. nu h₁édomes súpniyom ne kénketi.
english: Dear one! Are you a dream? A dream does not drink milk; look, I drink! Then where am I? You are in my home. Am I your dream? I do not know. Then let us eat; a dream is not hungry.

pie: póh₂imen. kʷóti toy h₂óweyes h₁sénti? tísres h₂óweyes kʷétesres h₂óweyes pénkʷe-kʷe h₂óweyes. nu moy supnós h₁ludʰét. h₁sónt moy wéwke. septḿ̥ moy gʷówes h₁sénti ḱm̥tóm-kʷe moy márkons h₂énHōy h₁sénti. kʷíd toy h₁ésti? ḱwṓ moy h₁ésti.
english: Shepherd! How many sheep do you have? Three sheep, four sheep, and five sheep. And then sleep comes to me! Tell me the truth! I have seven cows, and my grandmother has a hundred horses. And what do you have? I have a dog.

pie: eḱwos wewekur, "ḱludʰe, owei! ḱerd angʰetai widontbʰyos: ǵʰm̥on, potis, wl̥nam owiyōm kʷr̥neti soi gʷʰermom westrom; owibʰyos kʷe wl̥nā ne esti".
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: pótey. h₃rḗǵs wos h₁ésti? h₃rḗǵs nos h₁ésti só h₂nr̥ménēs. méǵh₂ dh₂pnóm dʰǵʰyés déh₃t polh₁úh₂ nos péh₃tleh₂ déh₃t ph₃mé-kʷe gʷéHyome-kʷe. h₂én h₁és? h₂én h₁ésm̥ ḱósmi-kʷe dinósyo ḱémh₂m̥. h₃rḗǵs wos h₁ésti? h₃rḗǵs nos ne h₁ésti. nu wos kʷís dh₂pnéh₂ dédeh₃ti?
english: Master! Do you have a king? We have a king; he is Man-Minded. Yesterday he gave a great feast; he gave us many cups, and we drank and sang. Were you there? I was there, and today I am tired. Do you have a king? We have no king. Then who gives you feasts?

pie: h₁eǵóh₂ luǵrós. kʷíd príHe túH luǵrós? méh₂tēr moy péruti mért. ḱéh₂dos toy méǵh₂. h₁íh₂ toy ḱérdi h₁ésti h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe memónth₂e. h₁ésyeh₂s h₁nómn̥ gʷr̥nHdʰí h₁ésyeh₂s-kʷe ḱléwos gʷíh₃wēti. h₁íd gʷr̥néHoh₂. túH moy lewbʰós.
english: I am sad. Why are you sad, friend? My mother died last year. Your grief is great. She is in your heart, and you remember her. Praise her name, and her fame will live. I will praise it. You are dear to me.

pie: wíḱpotey. túH deywós? smḗymi. h₁eǵóh₂ ne deywós bʰágōs ne m̥rént méroh₂-kʷe. polh₁úh₂ wóydth₂e. márkons kéh₂nmn̥h₂-kʷe wóydh₂e. túH dʰéh₁s? h₁eǵóh₂ ne dʰéh₁s h₁eǵóh₂ wiHrós.
english: Lord of the house! Are you a god? I am laughing! I am not a god; gods do not die, and I shall die. And you know many things. I know horses and songs. And are you a god? I am not a god; I am a man.

pie: h₁éḱwōs toy HeHḱéwes. tóy moy mówdos. ḱós pṓlHos dʰǵʰyés ǵn̥h₁yéto. h₂uksyéh₁t. túH h₁suménēs. h₁ím Hmolḱéye. ǵʰésorm̥ moy léyǵʰti.
english: Your horses are swift. They are my joy. This foal was born yesterday. May he grow up! You are kindly. Pat him! He is licking my hand!

pie: deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént. kóryom h₁éysi? bʰréh₂teres moy kóryom h₁yénti h₁eǵóh₂ moy méh₂term̥ péh₂smi. gʰósteyes nos gʷṓs péruti stéh₂yont h₁íns-kʷe h₂ew h₂éǵome. h₁íns gʷʰnént? dwóh₁ wiHróh₁ gʷʰnént tréyes-kʷe wiHrṓs bʰugént. kóryos wos h₁ésti? kóryos kʷelsóy h₁ésti.
english: May the gods give you good things! Do you go to war? My brothers go to war; I guard my mother. Last year strangers stole our cattle, and we drove them back. Did they kill them? They killed two men, and three fled. Do you have war? There is war far away.

pie: pótey. suHnús moy ǵn̥h₁yéto. kʷód h₁nómn̥ h₁ésmey dʰéh₁oh₂? ḱód méǵh₂s mówdos. h₁ésmey h₁nómn̥ h₁suḱléwesm̥ dʰh₁dʰí. h₁yód dʰugh₂tḗr ǵn̥h₁yḗtor? nu h₁ésyeh₂ey h₁nómn̥ h₁suh₁éḱweh₂m dʰh₁dʰí. kʷíd toy h₁nómn̥?
english: Lord! A son was born to me. What name shall I give him? This is a great joy! Set him the name Of-Good-Fame. And if a daughter is born? Then set her the name Of-Good-Horses. And what is your name?

pie: kʷíd tód? tód ne ḱlḗm. só wóǵʰos h₁éḱwōs-kʷe h₁ím ne dukénti. nu kʷís h₁ím déwkti? bʰágos? dʰégʷʰonts wóǵʰos. ne h₁éwsetor? ne h₁éwsetor. márkōs moy tód mē ḱluwih₁ént.
english: Where I live, we drive cars. What is that? I have not heard of that. It is a wagon, and horses do not pull it. Then who pulls it? A god? An engine pulls it; it burns gasoline. A wagon that burns! Does it not burn? It does not burn. May my horses never hear of it!

pie: wíḱpotey h₁idʰé gʷm̥dʰí. kʷíd h₂usési h₁ḗds? h₂mélǵos péh₃m̥. nu gʷṓs h₂éǵrom h₂éǵom. h₂én wr̥ǵyési? ne wr̥ǵyóh₂ sísdoh₂ séngʷʰoh₂-kʷe dyḗm-kʷe spéḱyoh₂. kʷíd h₁ḗds?
english: Come here, master of the house! What did you eat at dawn? I drank milk. Then I drove the cattle to the field. Do you work there? I do not work; I sit, I sing, and I watch the sky. And what did you eat?

pie: spélom moy wéwke sméyoh₂-kʷe. h₂éwh₂os moy h₁éḱwom nékʷti h₁épt. nu h₁ím h₂usési kʷéḱt só gʷṓws h₁ést. h₂énHos-kʷe moy smḗyt. tód moy spélom lewbʰóm. nu moy túH spélom wéwke.
english: Tell me a story, and let me laugh! At night my uncle seized a horse. At dawn he caught sight of it: it was a cow! And my grandmother laughed. That story is dear to me! Now you tell me a story!

pie: wĺ̥kʷosyo moy spélom wéwke. wĺ̥kʷos h₂éǵrom nékʷti gʷémt. h₂ówins widét ḱwṓ-kʷe bʰéwdʰet. ḱwṓ h₁ím h₁épt ǵʰwḗr-kʷe nókʷtm̥ bʰéwgt. tód spélom h₁sónt? só ḱwṓ h₁idʰé ḱéyor.
english: Tell me the story of a wolf. A wolf came to the field at night. He saw the sheep, and the dog was awake. The dog seized him, and the beast fled into the night. Is that story true? That dog is lying here!

pie: h₁yód h₂nḗr méreti kúdʰe h₁éyti. dweh₂róy méǵh₂i wédni upér h₁éyti. swóns ph₂térn̥s h₂én widét dh₂pnóy-kʷe h₁épi sédyonti ne-kʷe kénkonti. mr̥téys dedwóyth₂e? ne dedwóyh₂e ḱléwos moy gʷíh₃weti. kʷósmōd túH dedwóyth₂e? mr̥téys dedwóyh₂e.
english: When a man dies, where does he go? He goes far away, over the great water. There he finds his fathers, and they sit at a feast and are not hungry. Are you afraid of death? I am not afraid; my fame will live. And you, what are you afraid of? I am afraid of death.

pie: néwos moy ḱwṓ h₁ésti ḱlutóm moy h₁nómn̥ dh₃dʰí. só HeHḱús? só HeHḱús h₂mélǵos-kʷe stéh₂yeti. nu h₁ésmey h₁nómn̥ HeHḱuwĺ̥kʷom dʰh₁dʰí. wĺ̥kʷōs h₁ésyo h₁némn̥s trésonti. tód moy h₁nómn̥ keh₂róm. h₁ím moy wédʰe h₁ím wéydsoh₂.
english: I have a new dog; give me a famous name! Is he swift? He is swift, and he steals milk. Then set him the name Swift-Wolf. Wolves tremble at his name. That name is dear to me. Bring him to me; I want to see him.

pie: túH ḱósyo ḱóymosyo pótnih₂? h₁eǵóh₂ pótnih₂ pótis moy wiḱpótis. suHnéwes toy h₁sénti? dwóh₁ moy suHnúh₁ dʰugh₂tḗr-kʷe h₁sénti. dʰugh₂tḗr moy h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe tkswós suHnúh₁-kʷe pṓlHons h₂éǵetes. téksi? ne téksmi. nu h₁idʰé sddʰí h₁ukdʰí-kʷe.
english: Are you the mistress of this house? I am the mistress; my husband is the master of the household. Do you have sons? I have two sons and a daughter. My daughter and I weave, and the two sons drive the foals. Do you weave? I do not weave. Then sit here and learn!

pie: wíḱpotey. túH h₁sónts? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁sónts ǵʰésorm̥ moy téth₂ge. gʷʰréh₁yeti? gʷʰréh₁yeti. h₁eǵóh₂ poh₂imḗn h₁ḗdmi píph₃oh₂-kʷe. túH h₁sónts? smḗymi.
english: Master of the household! Are you real? I am real; touch my hand. Is it warm? It is warm. I am a shepherd: I eat, and I drink. And you, are you real? I laugh!

pie: príHe nékʷth₁ bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. kʷíd bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? nókʷts h₂strṓm méh₂tēr. ǵʰwḗres h₁ógʷʰeyes-kʷe nékʷti gʷm̥yónti. ḱwṓ bʰéwdʰeti péh₂wr̥-kʷe dʰégʷʰeti h₂léksetes te. nókʷts h₂usési h₂epó yéh₂ti. nu ph₂wéni h₁épi légʰoh₂. l̥gʰdʰí supnós-kʷe toy gʷm̥yéh₁t.
english: Friend, I am afraid of the night. Why are you afraid? Night is the mother of the stars. Beasts and snakes come in the night. The dog is awake, and the fire burns; the two of them guard you. And at dawn the night goes away. Then I will lie down by the fire. Lie down, and may sleep come to you.

pie: póh₂imen h₁idʰé gʷm̥sḱé. kʷíd dʰǵʰyés widés? méǵh₂m̥ h₁ógʷʰim wédni h₁épi widóm h₂éḱmonm̥-kʷe gʷr̥h₃ét. tód h₁sónt? bʰoydʰéh₂m toy moy dédeh₃mi. bʰréh₂tēr toy h₂én bʰéh₂ti. légʰet supnós-kʷe h₁ím kapyét.
english: Come here, shepherd! What did you see yesterday? I saw a great snake by the water, and it swallowed a stone. Is that true? I give you my oath. Your brother says otherwise. He was lying down, and sleep held him!

pie: owis nu eḱwobʰ(y)os (eḱwomos) ewewkʷet, "ḱēr agʰnutoi moi eḱwōns aǵontm̥ nerm̥ widn̥tei".
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."
